preconditions.description: The number of bases n and the number of bases to remain k must satisfy 2 <= k <= n <= 500000.
Each base's coordinates must be within the range -10^9 to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: any((x, y) == (0, 0) for x, y in bases)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly one base at the origin (0, 0).

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximal possible sum of distances between all pairs of the remaining k bases.
